title: 第十一章借刀第十二章破境
slug: 扫地八十年从宗门杂役飞升成仙
lines: 马得水揉了揉眼睛看过去。
五官还是那样，但皮肤紧实，头发乌黑，整个人透着股旺盛的生机。
“你……你是叶凡？”
马得水指着叶凡，声音直接劈了叉，整个人都惊呆了。
叶凡装出惶恐，赶紧往前走两步弯下腰：“马管事，是我。”
马得水倒吸一口凉气，打量着叶凡，心里翻起惊涛骇浪。
返老还童？
这怎么可能！
他猛的想起正事，脸色一沉，厉声喝问：“少在这装神弄鬼！我问你，早上我派来找你的王二和李四呢？”
叶凡满脸茫然，挠挠后脑勺：“王二？李四？马管事，我没见过啊。我这几天一直在废丹洞里干活，连个鬼影子都没碰到。”
“放屁！”
马得水大怒，往前逼近一步。
“他们两个大活人，领了我的差事来这废阁，还能凭空消失了不成？”
叶凡连连摆手苦着脸喊冤：“管事明鉴，我真没见过。您也知道这废阁平时根本没人来，现在又只有我一个，我上哪去见他们？”
马得水盯着叶凡，试图找出破绽。
没有破绽。
叶凡的表情太自然了，那种底层杂役面对管事时的畏缩和讨好，拿捏的恰到好处。
马得水冷哼一声，视线再次扫过叶凡年轻的脸庞，质问道：“那你这副鬼样子是怎么回事？昨天还快死了，今天就活蹦乱跳了？”
叶凡叹口气拍拍大腿，做出一副懊恼的模样。
“管事，这事儿说起来我也觉得邪门。”
他压低声音凑近了点。
“昨晚我在废丹洞深处搬东西，实在饿的受不了。”
“突然闻到一股怪香，顺着味道找去，在石缝里发现一颗红彤彤的果子。”
马得水皱眉：“果子？”
叶凡点头。
“我当时饿疯了，也没多想，抓起来就塞嘴里。谁知道那果子一下肚，我整个人就疼的满地打滚，直接晕死过去。”
叶凡指了指自己的脸。
“等我早上醒过来，就变成这样了，我当时也吓了一跳，去水坑边照，还以为大白天撞邪了。”
他顿了顿，脸上露出极其肉痛的表情。
“变年轻是变年轻了，可我之前好不容易攒起来的那点修为，全没了！”
马得水听完，半信半疑。
感知被他放了出来，毫不客气的在叶凡身上扫了一圈。
叶凡装出一副难堪的模样，内心却雀跃无比，站在原地没动，任由对方探查。
九龙搬血重塑的肉身，将灵气死死锁在经脉深处。
content_en:
Ma Deshui rubbed his eyes and looked over.
The facial features are still the same, but the skin is firm, the hair is black, and the whole person exudes a strong sense of vitality.
"You...are you Ye Fan?"
Ma Deshui pointed at Ye Fan, his voice cracked, and everyone was stunned.
Ye Fan pretended to be frightened and quickly took two steps forward and bent down: "It's me who's in charge of the horse."
Ma Deshui took a breath of cold air and looked at Ye Fan, feeling turbulent in his heart.
Rejuvenation?
How is this possible!
He suddenly remembered the business, his face darkened, and he shouted sternly: "Stop pretending to be a ghost here! Let me ask you, where are Wang Er and Li Si I sent to find you this morning?"
Ye Fan looked confused and scratched the back of his head: "Wang Er? Li Si? Manager Ma, I've never seen him before. I've been working in the Waste Pill Cave these past few days, and I haven't even met a ghost."
"Fart!"
Ma Deshui was furious and took a step forward.
"These two living men came to this ruined pavilion on my errand, how could they disappear out of thin air?"
Ye Fan repeatedly waved his hands and complained with a grimace: "Guanshi Mingjian, I really have never seen it. You also know that no one comes to this abandoned pavilion usually, and now I am the only one. Where can I see them?"
Ma Deshui stared at Ye Fan, trying to find the flaw.
No flaws.
Ye Fan's expression was so natural, the kind of cowering and flattering attitude of a low-level handyman when facing a supervisor, and he had it just right.
Ma Deshui snorted coldly, glanced at Ye Fan's young face again, and asked: "Then what's the matter with you looking like this? You were almost dead yesterday, but you are alive and kicking today?"
Ye Fan sighed and patted his thigh, looking annoyed.
"Steward, I feel evil when talking about this matter."
He lowered his voice and leaned closer.
"I was moving things deep in the Feidan Cave last night and I was so hungry that I couldn't bear it."
"Suddenly I smelled a strange fragrance. I followed the smell and found a red fruit in the crevices of the rocks."
Ma Deshui frowned: "Fruit?"
"Yes!"
Ye Fan nodded.
"I was so hungry that I didn't think much about it. I grabbed it and stuffed it into my mouth. Who knew that as soon as I got the fruit, I would roll on the floor in pain and fainted."
Ye Fan pointed at his face.
"When I woke up in the morning, it turned out like this. I was shocked at the time and went to the puddle to take a photo. I thought I had encountered something evil in broad daylight."
He paused, with an expression of extreme pain on his face.
"You are getting younger, but the cultivation I had managed to accumulate before is all gone!"
After hearing this, Ma Deshui was dubious.
The perception was released by him, and he swept around Ye Fan unceremoniously.
Ye Fan pretended to be embarrassed, but he was very happy inside. He stood still and allowed the other party to explore.
The body reshaped by Jiulong's blood has locked the spiritual energy deep in the meridians.
